teams.synopsis: The clear favorite for the 2025 championship — leading the league in points for by 17 a week over the runner-up.
teams.blurb: Simply the favorite to win the 2025 championship, STD may not have the best record ever, but they're having one of the best scoring seasons in league history. The team leads the league in PF, with the 2nd-most having 17 fewer points per week!!!! Perhaps they get over the hump this year. Current record: 9-4. Projected: 10-4.

teams.synopsis: A change of heart — no longer just the lucky regular-season team, but a legitimate threat to win it all.
teams.blurb: I'm changing my stance on this team. I used to think they were the classic lucky regular-season team that gets bounced early in the playoffs, but I now think they could legitimately win it all. Now, they did just put up 67 (XD) points in Week 13, but I think it was a fluke. Show something in Week 14. Current record: 10-3. Projected: 11-3.

teams.synopsis: Could miss the playoffs with a Week 14 loss at 3rd — a scary thought, but a dark horse if they get in.
teams.blurb: Having a team that could potentially miss the playoffs with a loss in Week 14 at 3rd may be crazy, but who cares. If RWB gets into the playoffs, I like their chances as a dark horse. The last time the team made the playoffs at 7-7? They went on to win it all... I'm getting deja vu. Current record: 6-7. Projected: 7-7.

teams.synopsis: Looking good for back-to-back seasons on top — a healthy Kamara putting up even a modest 12 a week makes this team dangerous.
teams.blurb: Can they go back-to-back? It's looking good for them. The x-factor will be their RB2 — if Kamara can get healthy and put up just 12 a week in the playoffs, the team will be dangerous. Until then, this team is beatable, but not one you can brush off. Current record: 8-5. Projected: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: A fall from grace after living in the top 2 from Weeks 4-13 — now more of a mid-tier playoff team.
teams.blurb: A fall from grace, MFGA was ranked within the top 2 from Weeks 4-13, but as of now I view them as a mid playoff team. The team has shown a consistent high ceiling at times this season, but as of recent they've failed to reach even 110 points. Let's see how they do in Week 14. Current record: 10-3. Projected: 10-4.

teams.synopsis: Perhaps the sneakiest potential playoff team in the league — low in points for, but the ceiling is high enough for a deep run.
teams.blurb: Perhaps the sneakiest potential playoff team in the league, they're only 10th in PF this season and they've been meh the past month or so, but we know the ceiling is high, and that's all you need to make a deep playoff run. A win in Week 14 basically makes them a lock, but let's see. Current record: 6-7. Projected: 7-7.

teams.synopsis: Good on paper almost all season, but never quite put it together consistently enough to be a top team.
teams.blurb: Looking over this roster while ranking today, I realized they've been good on paper almost the entire season, but they just haven't put it together consistently enough to be a top-ranked team. There's a chance they miss the playoffs for the first time ever, like OHLC, but I think they'll get in. Current record: 6-7. Projected: 7-7.

teams.synopsis: A brutal run of injuries lands this team at 8th heading into Week 14 — already a playoff lock regardless.
teams.blurb: A brutal collection of injuries in these past couple of weeks lands LP as the 8th-ranked team heading into Week 14. They're already a lock for playoffs, but don't be surprised if they get bounced in the 1st round. Good luck to the franchise as they attempt to secure a 2nd franchise championship. Current record: 8-5. Projected: 8-6.

teams.synopsis: A true rollercoaster season — a 3-game win streak, a 5-game skid, another 3-game streak, and now back-to-back losses.
teams.blurb: Really a rollercoaster of a season for this team. First, they start off on a 3-game winning streak, then they lose 5 in a row, then win 3 in a row again, and now have dropped the last 2 weeks. I have them losing in Week 14 and missing the playoffs for the first time ever. Current record: 6-7. Projected: 6-8.

teams.synopsis: A real shot at the 7th or 8th seed thanks to an easy Week 14 matchup, even if the run ends quickly in Round 1.
teams.blurb: There's a very real chance this team makes the playoffs as either the 7th or 8th seed due to the easy matchup in Week 14. Still, I have them missing the playoffs even with the projected win, but if they get in, I think their season ends in Round 1. Good luck! Current record: 6-7. Projected: 7-7.

teams.synopsis: A solid stretch derailed by a 96-point dud in Week 13 — a slim chance to sneak into the playoffs remains.
teams.blurb: It sucks we most likely won't see this team in the playoffs again since they had a solid stretch of performances before a 96-point dud in Week 13. There's still a chance for them to sneak in, but it's very slim. If only Jettas had a QB to get him the ball... Current record: 5-8. Projected: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: Hot the past couple weeks, but that's unlikely to continue — only twice all season have they cracked 120 points.
teams.blurb: They've been hot the past couple weeks, but will that continue into this week? I don't think so, and that's why I've got them staying at 12th. The team has only scored more than 120 points in a given week twice this season, so I don't think they'll even be able to win in the playoffs if they get in. Current record: 6-7. Projected: 6-8.

teams.synopsis: So much preseason hype, but it never materialized — a hotter Jameson stretch might have changed everything.
teams.blurb: There was a lot of talk after the draft around this team and how they'd lead the franchise to their best season ever, but unfortunately for them that never came to be. Had Jameson hit this stride earlier, I think the team would be fighting for a playoff spot in Week 14. Current record: 3-10. Projected: 4-10.

teams.synopsis: McDonald's it is — on pace for one of the worst seasons in league history, with only Warren as a real bright spot.
teams.blurb: Welp, McDonald's it is for TTF. This team is on pace to have one of, if not the, worst seasons in league history. It doesn't help that Nabers went down with injury early on, but the rest of the team just underperformed almost the entire season, with the only bright spot being Warren. Current record: 2-11. Projected: 2-12.
